scripts.model: jar=$(ls ../../target/*-cli.jar 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$jar" ]; then echo 'The compiler has not been built. From the repository root: mvn package' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f ../../packages/wasm/dist/cli.js ]; then echo 'The glue has not been built. From packages/wasm: npm ci && npm run build' >&2; exit 1; fi; java -jar "$jar" model -o public/cart.wasm && souther-wasm-bindings public/cart.wasm -o src/cart.ts
scripts.build: npm run model && tsc --noEmit && vite build
